concept.title: What is Docker?
concept.shortdesc: Docker packages an application and everything it needs into a portable unit called a container.

conbody.p: A container is a lightweight, isolated environment that runs an application together with its dependencies. A container behaves the same way on a laptop, on a test server and in the cloud.
Docker works with four main components:

dlentry.dd: The command-line tool you use to send commands, such as docker build.
The background service that builds, runs and manages containers.
A read-only package that contains the files, libraries and configuration needed to run a container.
A storage location for images. Docker Hub is a public registry. Amazon ECR is a private registry on AWS.

conbody.p: When you run an image, it becomes a container.
